subject.title: fix(agents): ApiKeyRetryParams passes apiKeyIndex instead of attemptNumber to attempt parameter

question: Should `executeWithApiKeyRotation` preserve the historical `attempt` key-rotation index, change it to an operation attempt count, or add explicit fields while leaving `attempt` compatible?
rationale: The helper is plugin-SDK-visible and the historical implementation used `attempt` as the key-list index, so automation should not silently choose a breaking callback semantic.

options.title: Add Explicit Fields
options.body: Add `apiKeyIndex` and `attemptNumber` to the callback payload, keep `attempt` compatible or deprecate it, and cover both fields in focused tests.

options.title: Change `attempt` Semantics
options.body: Make `attempt` mean operation attempt count and accept the compatibility risk for plugin callers that relied on the old rotation-index meaning.

options.title: Document Current Contract
options.body: Keep the runtime unchanged and document that `attempt` is the key-rotation index while directing same-key retry logic to `transientRetry.shouldRetry`.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Fields
recommendation.body: Add `apiKeyIndex` and `attemptNumber` to the callback payload, keep `attempt` compatible or deprecate it, and cover both fields in focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the rotation helper and carried much of the follow-up retry contract work, making him the best available owner for the callback API decision.
